description: qou-d0qq, the construction half of Step-2 option C, as far as it is computable. (1) The level is fixed convention-free by the eigenvalue RATIO of the KZ half-twist: split Casimir 1/4 on Sym², −3/4 on Λ² ⇒ ratio −e^{iπħ}; matching the Hecke ratio −q² gives q² = e^{iπħ}, i.e. ħ = (2/iπ) ln q — purely imaginary at the real proton pin (the 'imaginary level'), conditional on the §7a Skein normalisation (H) — under (J) the ratio is −q and ħ halves; k+2 = 15.05 i / 30.1 i / 60.2 i for ħ = 1/(k+2), 2/(k+2), 4/(k+2). (2) The pulled-back monodromy ϱ: F₆ → B₃ → End(V^{⊗3}) is explicit from the six measured lasso words: every ϱ(w_j) satisfies the Hecke quadratic and has pivotal trace z_D; the image is that of B₃; ϱ(w₁⋯w₆) = ϱ(Δ²) is central with two distinct eigenvalues (the two isotypic blocks). (3) Nothing here evaluates the framework side: no connection object exists there; KZPullbackGenerators is the interface. q₀ is an input only; nothing outputs a q₀.

parameters.R_matrix: eigenvalues q (Sym^2), -1/q (Lambda^2); K = diag(q, 1/q); tr_D = tr(K^{⊗n} X)/[2]^n

level.matching: q^2 = e^{i pi hbar}; hbar = (2/(i pi)) ln q

data.verdict: The KZ side of Step-2 option C is now explicit and exact: level from the eigenvalue ratio, representation from the measured lasso words, Markov parameter z_D recovered without a choice. The remaining hypothesis is on the framework side — that the substrate connection IS this pulled-back connection — and the corpus has no connection object to compare; the class KZPullbackGenerators names it. Not a derivation of q0; not a fit.

caveats: Kohno–Drinfeld (the KZ half-twist monodromy is the R-matrix) is cited (kohno1987, drinfeld1985), not held in library/ and not re-derived here; (1) uses only its eigenvalue statement.
Scope: n = 3 strands (V^{⊗3}); the six words are the measured ones, hard-coded with their source and cross-checked against the B1 witness when present.
